narrative: 地狱、工业、一个关于城市的笑话：潮湿的工业地面，油桶可以作为道具出现，但不当作象征符号，一个身影置身其中。氛围本身就是污染。
一场田园野餐在这里活不下去。如果你只是给画面染上一层绿色，它就是错误的工具。
展现出空气作为一种物质的质感。不要出现生化危害的文字标识。
生成模型会把文字画得一团糟。
how: 平视或略低的高度，35mm焦段，固定机位。给烟雾打逆光，让毒气变得可见。
刺眼的绿色和尿液般的黄色，潮湿的地面，一个身影。Prompt: Toxic air around [Subject], sick greens, yellow haze, poison you can see.
when: 工业地狱、一座关于毒气的城市玩笑、一个危险节拍。不要用在田园野餐上，也不要用绿色LUT来蒙混过关。
vs: 雾（Fog）是空气中的水分，通常是白色或灰色。粒子（Particles）是没有化学法则的碎屑。
毒气风则是带有病态色板的烟雾，用逆光让空气变成一种物质。如果你看不到毒气，你得到的只是一种调色，而不是这个风格。
examples_film: 《切尔诺贝利》（Chernobyl）把空气拍成一种几乎能被看见的危险。漫画式的黏液是它那个广为人知的图形化近亲：一种能杀死你的天气。
这是污染的语法，而不是一个标识。
mistakes: 没有烟雾的青色或绿色调色，或危害标识。破绽是干净的空气。
修正方法：可见的毒气、逆光、病态的绿色和黄色，以及置身其中的一个身体。

faq.q: 电影中的毒气风（Toxic）是什么？
faq.a: 化学天气：病态的绿色、黄色的雾霭、你能看见的烟雾。空气本身就是危险。一个绿色LUT是不够的。
雾是水滴，通常是中性的。毒气风则是带有病态色板和可见烟雾的污染。如果空气是白色且无害的，你想要的是雾。
工业、地狱、一座中毒的城市。跳过野餐和干净空气的调色。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写毒气风的提示词？
faq.a: 先给烟雾打逆光，然后禁止出现生化危害的文字标识。保持一个清晰可辨的身影。

narrative: Hell, industry, a joke about a city: wet industrial ground, drums optional as objects not as icons, a figure in it. Atmosphere as contamination.
A pastoral picnic dies here. It is the wrong tool when you only tint the frame green.
Show the air as matter. No biohazard letters.
how: Eye height or slightly low, 35mm, lock-off. Backlight the fumes so the poison is visible.
Acid greens and urine yellows, wet ground, a figure. Prompt: Toxic air around [Subject], sick greens, yellow haze, poison you can see.
when: Industrial hell, a city as a joke about poison, a hazard beat. Do not use it on a pastoral picnic, and do not fake it with a green LUT.
vs: Fog is water in air, usually white or grey. Particles is bits without a chemical law.
Toxic is fumes with a sick palette, backlight so the air is matter. If you cannot see the poison, you have a grade, not this look.
examples_film: Chernobyl treats air as a hazard you can almost see. Comic-book ooze is the well-known graphic cousin: weather that can kill you.
Grammar of contamination, not a logo.
mistakes: A teal or green grade with no fumes, or hazard icons. The tell is clean air.
Fix it: visible poison, backlight, sick green and yellow, a body in it.

faq.a: Chemical weather: sick greens, yellow haze, fumes you can see. The air is the hazard. A green LUT is not enough.
Fog is water droplets, usually neutral. Toxic is contamination with a sick palette and visible fumes. If the air is white and harmless, you wanted fog.
Industry, hell, a poisoned city. Skip picnics and clean-air grades.

faq.q: How do I prompt Toxic for AI image or video?
faq.a: Backlight fumes, then: Toxic air around [Subject], sick greens, yellow haze, poison you can see. Forbid biohazard letters. Keep a readable figure.
